CustomField.description: Term end printed on the Contributor Order Form: the later of the subscription term end and the latest line end, so a cross-sold edition running past the subscription year is covered.
CustomField.formula: IF(ISBLANK(Order_Form_Term_End__c), Order_Form_Line_Term_End__c, IF(AND(NOT(ISBLANK(Order_Form_Line_Term_End__c)), Order_Form_Line_Term_End__c > Order_Form_Term_End__c), Order_Form_Line_Term_End__c, Order_Form_Term_End__c))
CustomField.label: Order Form: term end (display)
